name: logo_title
style: This is the game's title logo. Recreate it in Korean with the same design language: '케이온!' in big chunky bubbly red/orange letters with a thick cream outline and drop shadow (same size and position as けいおん!), keep the small 'K-ON!' mark above it; '방과후' in the same green brush-like letters with white outline, and '라이브!!' in the same orange letters. Keep the treble clef and music notes decoration. In the original, the letter お contains a white electric-guitar silhouette; put the same guitar silhouette inside the circle of '온'. Make the Korean lettering hand-drawn and playful like the original, not a plain font. Keep '방과후' and '라이브!!' with a small gap like the original.
